summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Hands on generative AI and model optimization experience: built a GPT2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and an 8 bit quantized LLM.int8() compression pipeline that cut TinyLlama 1.1B's memory footprint by 55% with under 1% accuracy loss. Shipped Python systems end to end, including a Flask SocketIO backend and a Gemini integrated robotics pipeline across a distributed, three layer architecture.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free document understanding transformer) for structured medical billing field extraction.
Built PyTorch training pipelines using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API with domain-specific tokenization.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student on a medical imaging pipeline; took over as team lead mid-project to restructure task distribution and deliver within a 6-week window.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled VRAM and latency with pynvml.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; under 1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Trained on a small fantasy-themed text corpus; validated text generation and model understanding of Transformer architecture fundamentals.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled pick-and-place system across a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, and Jetson+Arduino over WebSocket.
Integrated faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification (under 500ms), and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) for real-time voice-to-action control.
Resolved 11 integration failures; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation - 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop - Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon - National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
